title: Nike and Mumbai Indians Announce a Multi-Year Kit Partnership
summary: Nike and Mumbai Indians, one of the most successful franchises in global cricket, are announcing a multi-year partnership that names Nike the official kit partner of both its women’s and men’s team in India, beginning with the 2027 season.
body_markdown:
Nike and Mumbai Indians, one of the most successful franchises in global cricket, today announced a multi-year partnership that names Nike the official kit partner of both its women’s and men’s team in India, beginning with the 2027 season.


The partnership brings together the ambition, audacity and relentless energy of Mumbai with the leading brand in global sport, beginning a bold new chapter for the team, its athletes and the passionate Paltan fan community.


The announcement also marks a significant step in Nike’s continued investment in cricket, reflecting the brand’s long-term commitment to athletes, fans and the future of sport in India.


Nike will outfit both teams, including their coaches and technical staff, across match play, training and sportswear, bringing the brand’s innovative apparel offerings to athletes and the millions of fans who wear the Mumbai Indians’ blue and gold with pride.


“Cricket is woven into the heartbeat of India, and few teams capture its energy like Mumbai Indians,” says Tarundeep Singh, General Manager, Nike India. “The club embodies the ambition and belief that make sport so powerful. That's exactly what drew Nike to this partnership, which represents our effort to serve athletes, celebrate the game and help inspire the next generation.”


Mumbai Indians have built a legacy of identifying talent, backing potential and pursuing excellence across women’s and men’s cricket while building one of the world’s largest and most engaged fan communities. Nike and Mumbai Indians share a belief in the power of sport to unlock human potential and inspire the next generation, whether competing at the highest level or picking up a bat for the first time.


Beyond the pitch, Nike and Mumbai Indians will connect sport and culture through product and storytelling inspired by the identity of Mumbai. From the stadium to the streets, the partnership will celebrate the city’s identity and give fans new ways to express their connection to the team and the game.


“Mumbai Indians have always been about more than cricket,” says Devang Bhimjyani, Head, Reliance Sports. “We are one family — our players, our Paltan — built on nurturing talent, backing it fearlessly, and playing for a city that never stops. Nike shares our belief in athletes and in the power of sport to inspire. Together, we see an opportunity to connect cricket and culture, inspire the next generation, and take the spirit of MI and Mumbai to fans around the world."


Athletes and staff will begin wearing Nike team gear this month, and the women’s and men’s teams will reveal new Nike kits ahead of their respective 2027 seasons. Fans will soon be able to experience Nike’s apparel offerings through both team kits and additional styles inspired by the identity, energy and culture of Mumbai.


“Mumbai Indians backed me and gave me the opportunity to express myself on the big stage. Nike has been part of my journey too, so bringing these two families together feels personal,” says Tilak Varma, Nike athlete and member of the Mumbai Indians men’s team. “Wearing the MI colors with the Nike Swoosh will remind me of how far I’ve come — and how much more I want to achieve. Somewhere, there’s a kid in the nets dreaming of playing in blue and gold. I want them to see us and think, *That could be me.* ”
